0002_channels
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE channels (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspaces(id), name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(length(description) <= 1000), is_private INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(is_private IN (0,1)), created_by TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(workspace_id,name), UNIQUE(workspace_id,id));
CREATE TABLE channel_members (channel_id TEXT NOT NULL, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL, last_read_at INTEGER, joined_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(channel_id,user_id), FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id,channel_id) REFERENCES channels(workspace_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id,user_id) REFERENCES workspace_members(workspace_id,user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE);
